issues.title: GPS Not Working
solutions: Go to Settings > Privacy > Location Services > Spotimization > Enable
Enable 'High Accuracy' mode in Location Settings
Close and reopen the app
Power off and restart your device

issues.title: Map Not Loading
issues.problem: Map shows blank or doesn't display
solutions: Verify Wi-Fi or cellular data is working
Settings > App > Clear Cache
Check for latest app version
Delete and reinstall the app

issues.title: Can't Drop Pin
issues.problem: Unable to select parking spot on map
solutions: Zoom closer to area for better pin accuracy
Tap exact spot on the street, not the edge
Close and reopen the map view
Ensure Location Services are enabled

issues.title: Match Not Found
issues.problem: Waiting for match but no one matched
solutions: Try broader arrival and departure time windows
Ensure your spot is in a populated area
Matches take time, especially during early or late hours
Try a nearby location if available

issues.title: App Crashes
solutions: Install the latest version (check Settings > About)
Settings > App > Clear Cache
Ensure your phone has available storage space
Delete and reinstall the app
Update your phone to the latest OS version

issues.title: Notifications Not Working
issues.problem: Don't receive match or tracking notifications
solutions: Settings > Notifications > Spotimization > Enable All
Ensure your device isn't muted or in Do Not Disturb mode
Enable Background App Refresh in Settings
Power off and restart your device
